templates.name: Good Morning & Good Night
templates.description: A matching pair: a warm sunrise card for the morning and a quiet moonlit card for the night. Two cards, one order.

fields.label: Good morning message
fields.default: I hope today is gentle with you and full of small, happy surprises. Know that you are on my mind from the very first light.

fields.label: Good night message
fields.default: Rest easy tonight. Whatever today held, you handled it beautifully. Sleep well and dream of something lovely.

gmMessage: Habari ya asubuhi! Wishing you a calm, bright day ahead. You've got this.
The sun is up and so is my smile, because I'm thinking of you.
gnMessage: Usiku mwema. Thank you for being the best part of my day.
Close your eyes, let today go, and rest. I'll be thinking of you.

templates.name: Roses & Gold
templates.description: A loose spray of roses with fine gold detailing above an open, generous space for what you want to say.

fields.label: Greeting or headline
fields.default: For you, with all my heart

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Every day with you feels like a gift I never want to stop unwrapping. Thank you for your patience, your laughter, and the way you make ordinary days feel special.

message: You are my favourite hello and my hardest goodbye.
Nakupenda — today, tomorrow, and every ordinary day in between.
Thank you for choosing me, again and again.

templates.name: Pink Peonies
templates.description: Full, soft peonies tumbling in from the corner — a gentle, generous design that suits love, gratitude and celebration.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Some people make the world softer just by being in it. You are one of them, and I wanted you to know how much you are appreciated.

message: You deserve every beautiful thing coming your way.
A little bloom to remind you how loved you are.
Thank you for being so wonderfully you.

templates.name: Golden Years
templates.description: Interlocking rings inside a fine laurel wreath, with space for the date or number of years you are celebrating.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Here's to every year behind us and every adventure still ahead. I would choose you all over again.

message: Another year of loving you, and I still can't believe my luck.
To many more years of laughter, patience and growing together.
Wishing you both a love that only grows deeper with time.

templates.name: Birthday Balloons
templates.description: Bright balloons and paper confetti for a cheerful, joyful birthday — playful without being childish.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Wishing you a year full of laughter, good health and everything your heart is quietly hoping for. Enjoy your day — you deserve it.

title: Heri ya siku ya kuzaliwa!
Happy Birthday!
Cheers to another year
message: May this new year bring you closer to every dream you're chasing.
Eat the cake, dance a little, and know you are deeply loved.
Another trip around the sun — and you only get better.

templates.name: Asante Botanical
templates.description: Fine botanical sprigs framing a simple, heartfelt thank-you. Calm enough for a teacher, warm enough for a friend.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Your kindness did not go unnoticed. Thank you for your time, your care, and for showing up when it mattered.

title: Asante sana
Thank you
With heartfelt thanks
message: Thank you for everything you have done for me this year.
Your support made all the difference. I'm truly grateful.
For your patience, guidance and kindness — thank you.

templates.name: Cap & Laurel
templates.description: A tasselled graduation cap crowned with laurel leaves, with room for the graduate's name and achievement.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: All those late nights, early mornings and quiet sacrifices brought you here. We are so proud of you — the world is ready for what you'll do next.

fields.label: Achievement or course
fields.placeholder: e.g. Bachelor of Commerce, First Class Honours

message: You did it! This is only the beginning of great things.
Proud doesn't even begin to cover it. Hongera!
Your hard work paid off. Go and shine.

templates.name: Shine Bright
templates.description: A bold star inside a laurel for exam results, KCSE success, good-luck wishes and academic awards.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Your hard work has paid off. We are so proud of your results and of the person you are becoming. Keep reaching higher.

title: Well done!
Good luck!
Hongera sana!
message: Go into that exam room knowing you are prepared and capable. You've got this!
Your results speak for your effort. Congratulations!
This is what consistency looks like. Proud of you.

templates.name: New Chapter
templates.description: A sun rising over steady steps — for a new job, a promotion or any brave next step.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: They chose well. Wishing you a smooth start, great colleagues, and the kind of work that makes you proud.

fields.label: Role or company
fields.placeholder: e.g. Senior Accountant at Acme Ltd

title: Congratulations on your new role
Here's to your promotion
Onwards and upwards
message: Your hard work has been noticed — enjoy this moment.
New desk, new team, same brilliant you. Go get them!
Wishing you every success in this exciting new chapter.

templates.name: Olive Branch
templates.description: A single olive branch — the oldest sign of peace — with room for an honest, unhurried apology.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: I've been thinking about what happened, and I was wrong. You matter far more to me than being right. I hope we can talk, and I'll listen this time.

title: I'm sorry
Samahani
Can we start again?
message: I miss us. I'm sorry for my part, and I'd love to make it right.
No excuses — just a sincere apology, and a hope that you'll forgive me.
You deserved better from me. I'm sorry.

templates.name: Evergreen Christmas
templates.description: Pine boughs and glowing ornaments for a warm, classic Christmas greeting to family, friends or clients.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Wishing you a joyful Christmas filled with family, good food, laughter and peace — and a blessed new year ahead.

title: Merry Christmas
Krismasi Njema
Season's Greetings
message: May the peace and joy of Christmas stay with you all year long.
From our family to yours — a very merry Christmas!
Thank you for a wonderful year. Merry Christmas and a happy new year.

templates.name: New Year Sparkle
templates.description: Golden fireworks over a deep night sky to welcome the new year in style.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Here's to fresh starts, bold dreams and twelve new months of good things. May this year be your best one yet.

title: Happy New Year
Heri ya Mwaka Mpya
Cheers to the new year
message: Wishing you health, peace and prosperity in the year ahead.
New year, new chapters. I can't wait to see what you'll write.
Thank you for being part of my year. Here's to the next one!

templates.name: Tulips for Mama
templates.description: A tidy bunch of tulips tied with ribbon — a soft, grateful card for Mum, Mama or a mother figure.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Thank you for every sacrifice, every prayer and every hug. Everything good in me started with you.

message: Mama, you are my first home and my forever friend.
Thank you for loving me even on my difficult days.
To the strongest, kindest woman I know — happy Mother's Day.

templates.name: Steady Mountains
templates.description: Layered mountains under a clear sky — strong, quiet and steady, like the man you're celebrating.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Thank you for your strength, your advice and the quiet ways you've always looked out for us. We're proud to be yours.

message: Baba, thank you for showing me what hard work and kindness look like.
My first hero, my forever role model. Happy Father's Day!
For every lesson and every sacrifice — thank you, Dad.

templates.name: Garden Arch
templates.description: A floral garden arch framing two rings — for wedding wishes, ruracio congratulations and save-the-dates.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Wishing you a lifetime of love, patience and laughter. May your home always be full of warmth.

title: Congratulations on your wedding
Save the date
Mr & Mrs
message: Two hearts, one beautiful journey. Congratulations!
May your love grow stronger with every passing year.
We're so happy for you both. Here's to forever.

templates.name: Hello, Little One
templates.description: A sleepy crescent moon, soft clouds and stars to welcome a new baby or celebrate a baby shower.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Congratulations on your beautiful new arrival. Wishing your growing family sleep-filled nights and joy-filled days.

title: Welcome to the world
Oh baby!
Hello, little one
message: Congratulations on your little miracle!
Tiny hands, tiny feet, endless love. Congratulations!
Wishing your baby shower all the love and laughter in the world.

templates.name: Sunny Daisies
templates.description: Bright daisies reaching toward the sun — a cheerful, hopeful card for someone on the mend.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Sending healing thoughts and lots of love your way. Rest, take it slow, and know that we're thinking of you.

title: Get well soon
Pona haraka
Sending healing vibes
message: Wishing you a speedy and complete recovery.
Rest up — we need you back soon!
Thinking of you and praying for strength and healing.

templates.name: Quiet Lilies
templates.description: A restrained, respectful design with a single stem of lilies. Space for a gentle message of condolence.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: We are so sorry for your loss. May you find comfort in the love surrounding you and peace in cherished memories.

fields.label: In memory of
fields.placeholder: e.g. In loving memory of Mzee Joseph Mwangi

title: With deepest sympathy
Pole sana
Thinking of you
message: Our hearts are with you and your family during this difficult time.
May the memories you shared bring you comfort in the days ahead.
Words fall short, but please know you are not alone.

templates.name: Two of Us
templates.description: Two intertwined loops and scattered dots — a playful, modern card for the friend who just gets you.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Thank you for the long chats, the honest advice and the laughter that makes everything better. I'm lucky to have you.

title: Friends like you are rare
Rafiki wa kweli
Thank you for being you
message: Through every season, you've been there. Thank you, friend.
Life is better with you in it. Simple as that.
To many more years of inside jokes and good memories.

templates.name: Light & Blessings
templates.description: Soft light pouring through an arched window — a reverent, non-denominational design for baptisms, dedications and days of faith.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: May grace and peace surround you on this special day, and may your faith continue to light your way.

title: Blessings to you
On your baptism
On your dedication
message: May this day be the beginning of a beautiful journey of faith.
Praying that God's peace and favour follow you always.
Celebrating this blessed day with you and your family.

templates.name: Eid Lanterns
templates.description: A golden crescent and hanging lanterns on deep emerald — an elegant greeting for Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Wishing you and your loved ones a joyful Eid filled with peace, blessings and togetherness.

title: Eid Mubarak
Eid Saeed
Blessed Eid
message: May Allah accept your prayers and fill your home with peace.
Wishing you joy, blessings and good food with family this Eid.
Eid Mubarak to you and your family!

templates.name: With Appreciation
templates.description: A clean monogram frame for clients, partners and staff. Understated enough for business, personal enough to matter.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: We truly appreciate your trust and partnership this year. It has been a pleasure working with you, and we look forward to what's next.

title: Thank you for your business
With appreciation
Season's greetings
message: Thank you for being a valued client. We're grateful for your support.
To our wonderful team: thank you for your dedication this year.
Your partnership means a great deal to us. Thank you.

templates.name: Paper Hearts
templates.description: Layered paper hearts in rose and wine — a sweet, modern Valentine's card.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: You make my heart do that thing it does. Happy Valentine's Day to my favourite person.

title: Be my Valentine
Happy Valentine's Day
Nakupenda
message: Of all the hearts in the world, mine chose you.
You're the reason I believe in love stories.
Every day is Valentine's Day with you.

templates.name: Hongera!
templates.description: A joyful burst of confetti for any big win — engagements, new homes, results, launches and more.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: What a moment! Congratulations on this well-deserved achievement. Enjoy every bit of it.

title: Hongera!
Congratulations!
You did it!
message: So happy for you — you've earned this.
Big news deserves a big celebration. Congratulations!
Here's to you and this amazing milestone.

templates.name: Golden Horizon
templates.description: A slow sunset over calm water for a well-earned retirement or a heartfelt send-off.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: After years of dedication, it's time to rest, travel and enjoy every unhurried morning. Thank you for everything you've given.

title: Happy Retirement
Enjoy the next adventure
Farewell and thank you
message: You've earned every bit of this rest. Enjoy it!
Your wisdom and kindness will be missed. Happy retirement!
Here's to slow mornings and endless possibilities.

templates.name: Classic Invitation
templates.description: An ornate double border with plenty of space for event details. Works for parties, launches, dedications and announcements.

fields.label: Invitation text
fields.default: Please join us as we celebrate a special day with family and friends. Your presence would mean so much.

message: Join us for an afternoon of food, music and good company.
We'd love for you to celebrate this milestone with us.
Save the date — more details to follow.

templates.name: Easter Morning
templates.description: White lilies at sunrise for a bright, hopeful Easter greeting.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: Wishing you the joy and hope of Easter, and a blessed time with family and friends.

title: Happy Easter
He is risen
Pasaka Njema
message: May the hope of Easter fill your heart and home.
Wishing you a joyful, peaceful Easter weekend.
Celebrating new beginnings with you this Easter.

templates.name: Wildflower Meadow
templates.description: A loose meadow of wildflowers along the bottom edge — an open, versatile design for any message or occasion.

fields.label: Your message
fields.default: No special reason — I just wanted you to know I'm thinking of you and wishing you well.

title: Just because
Thinking of you
Missing you
message: You crossed my mind today, and it made me smile.
Sending a little sunshine your way.
Whatever you're going through, you're not alone.
